candidate_windows.window_text: We use 2 separate Transformer stacks as the encoder and decoder. Each stack has 2 layers, 2 heads per layer, 64 hidden units per head, and a feedforward dimension of 256. We train all our models using the Adam Optimizer (Kingma and Ba, 2015) with a constant learning rate of $5^{-3}$ , $\beta_{1} = 0.9$ , $\beta_{2} = 0.98$ . Each model is trained on an NVidia V100 for $\sim 16$ hours with the batch size of 512. We use the same encoder-embedding regularization coefficient of 0.01 as Li et al. (2019).
